verdict.rationale: gstack publishes a browsable skills table on GitHub (docs/skills.md, e.g. /plan-design-review). The README describes '23 opinionated tools' with roles, so a developer can review the available skills before installing. This is a static first-party list of one bundled pack, though, not a searchable registry, leaderboard, or marketplace; the only registry presence is a community member republishing it to the third-party gitagent registry. Missing for 10: searchable catalog or registry, marketplace or leaderboard listing, discovery of skills beyond gstack's own bundle, first-party registry distribution.
